question: At system scale, what is the main purpose of dividing a large collection network into smaller sewershed basins?

It lets managers compare performance and target work basin by basin
It makes every pipe in the system the same age
It eliminates the need for lift stations

optionB: It lets managers compare performance and target work basin by basin

question: The foundation of an effective fats, oils and grease program is which combination?
correctAnswer: Identified food service sources, clear discharge requirements and tracked interceptor maintenance
explanation: FOG control works at the source: known dischargers, enforceable requirements and proof that interceptors are maintained.
options: More frequent cleaning with no source records
A poster campaign with no follow up of any kind
Identified food service sources, clear discharge requirements and tracked interceptor maintenance
Larger sewers installed under every restaurant
optionA: More frequent cleaning with no source records
optionB: A poster campaign with no follow up of any kind
optionC: Identified food service sources, clear discharge requirements and tracked interceptor maintenance
optionD: Larger sewers installed under every restaurant
sourceTitle: US EPA — CMOM Guide for Sanitary Sewer Collection Systems

question: A hotspot keeps blocking despite frequent cleaning. The leadership action with the best long term result is to do what?
correctAnswer: Investigate upstream sources and require source control instead of only cleaning more often
explanation: Repeat blockages at one point signal an ongoing discharge; fixing the source ends the cycle that cleaning alone cannot.
options: Add the location to the cleaning list a second time each month
Declare the location a permanent cleaning cost
Investigate upstream sources and require source control instead of only cleaning more often
Reduce cleaning so the problem becomes visible to owners
optionA: Add the location to the cleaning list a second time each month
optionB: Declare the location a permanent cleaning cost
optionC: Investigate upstream sources and require source control instead of only cleaning more often
optionD: Reduce cleaning so the problem becomes visible to owners
sourceTitle: US EPA — CMOM Guide for Sanitary Sewer Collection Systems

question: Why do interceptor sizing and pumping records matter to a FOG program?
correctAnswer: Undersized or unmaintained interceptors pass grease to the sewer even though they are installed
explanation: An interceptor only protects the sewer when it is sized for the load and pumped before its capacity is used up, which records demonstrate.
options: Records prove an interceptor never needs pumping
Undersized or unmaintained interceptors pass grease to the sewer even though they are installed
A large interceptor removes the need for any inspections
Pumping records replace the discharge requirements
optionA: Records prove an interceptor never needs pumping
optionB: Undersized or unmaintained interceptors pass grease to the sewer even though they are installed
optionC: A large interceptor removes the need for any inspections
optionD: Pumping records replace the discharge requirements
sourceTitle: US EPA - Alternative Wastewater Collection Systems Manual

question: Which measure best shows that a FOG program is succeeding?
correctAnswer: A sustained reduction in FOG related blockages and overflows in targeted areas
explanation: The program exists to prevent blockages and overflows, so a sustained fall in those events in target areas is the true measure.
options: A larger number of grease related complaints logged
More cleaning trucks purchased for the fleet
Longer interceptors listed in the inventory
A sustained reduction in FOG related blockages and overflows in targeted areas
optionA: A larger number of grease related complaints logged
optionB: More cleaning trucks purchased for the fleet
optionC: Longer interceptors listed in the inventory
optionD: A sustained reduction in FOG related blockages and overflows in targeted areas

question: Education of food service operators usually fails on its own when what is missing?
correctAnswer: Inspection and enforcement follow up that confirms practices actually changed
explanation: Without verification, good intentions fade; follow up inspection is what turns education into changed practice.
options: Inspection and enforcement follow up that confirms practices actually changed
A larger poster for the kitchen wall
A second copy of the same pamphlet
A list of other restaurants in the city

question: During a wet weather period, a sewershed produces 3,600 m3/day of infiltration and inflow along 120 km of sewer. What is the I&I rate per kilometre of sewer? Round to 0 decimal places.
correctAnswer: 30 m³/day per km
explanation: Rate = I&I volume / sewer length. Substitute the stated values: 3600 / 120 = 30 m³/day per km. Round only the final result to 0 decimal place(s). The result uses the assumptions stated in the question.

question: A wet well has a usable volume of 9,000 L between start and stop levels. Inflow is 50 L/s and the pump delivers 150 L/s. What is the total pump cycle time, fill time plus run time, in minutes? Round to 1 decimal place.
correctAnswer: 4.5 minutes
